The '''Odik system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odik II]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Odik system served as headquarters of the [[Fifth Deep Core Army]], the [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] assigned to the defense of the Deep Core. It later became the capital of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Cinzero Gann|Gann's]] [[Sector 5/Legends|Sector 5]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
